overview_description.description: Healine is a platform that connects people with healthcare services in the UAE. The service includes finding hospitals across the country. It also helps users locate clinics with detailed information and reviews. The platform allows booking of appointments with doctors in different specialties. It offers medical services such as lab tests, vaccinations, flu shots, and IV therapy. Health insurance plans can be compared and purchased through the platform. Users can also access medical reports and health analytics to follow their health progress.
